tools.name: get_french_company_timeline
tools.description:
Every dated change the French official gazette recorded for one company: share capital, legal name,
legal form, registered office, stated activity, plus insolvency judgments and the current insolvency
status.

Use this to answer "when did X change", "how has X evolved", "has X ever been in receivership".

Do NOT use it to get the current state of a company (today's address, today's headcount): it only
publishes what CHANGED. A field that never moved is not in the answer.
Coverage starts at 2008; a company may exist and have published nothing.

Announcements that only cite the SIREN without describing the company are excluded.

siren.description: Nine-digit SIREN, spaces and dots accepted. A SIRET minus its last five digits.

tools.name: get_french_company_announcements
tools.description:
What the French official gazette printed about companies you already track, since a date.
Answers "did anything happen to these companies", "any news on X since my last check".

Up to 20 companies per call. Every 5 companies spend one unit of the rate
limit (30 per minute per address, rounded up per call), so pass them in ONE call rather than one call each.

Entries are filtered on the PUBLICATION date, not the date of the act (16 days apart at the median).
An empty list means nothing was published, not that nothing happened.

items.description: Nine-digit SIREN, spaces and dots accepted. A SIRET minus its last five digits.

siren.description: The companies to look at. One call for all of them, not one call each.

since.description: Publication date to look back to, ISO 8601. Defaults to 30 days ago.

tools.name: get_french_insolvency_barometer
tools.description:
Insolvency openings in France over the last twelve complete months, against the twelve before, with
the monthly series and a split by nature (liquidation, receivership, safeguard).

Scope: the whole country by default, or one department, or one trade. Pass at most one of them.

This counts OPENING judgments only, and it counts judgments, not companies. The current month is
never included: still running, it would read as a collapse.

department.description: French department code. Two digits, 2A and 2B for Corsica, three digits overseas. Omit for the whole country.

trade.description: Trade, read from the words of the activity declared in the gazette. Omit for all trades.

tools.name: get_french_company_financials
tools.description:
The annual accounts one French company filed with the business register, fiscal year by fiscal year:
revenue, gross margin, EBITDA, EBIT, net income, and the thirteen ratios the INPI computes from them
(margins, financial autonomy, debt, liquidity, working capital, customer and supplier payment delays).

Use this to answer "what is the revenue of X", "is X profitable", "how has the turnover of X evolved",
"how indebted is X".

Accounts of the legal entity under this SIREN and consolidated accounts of its group are listed apart
and NEVER add up: a holding files a revenue of zero beside a group revenue in the billions. Quote the
perimeter with the figure. Filings kept confidential are not listed, and a missing fiscal year is not a
fiscal year at zero. Amounts are in euros as filed.

siren.description: Nine-digit SIREN, spaces and dots accepted. A SIRET minus its last five digits.

tools.name: get_french_company_ademe_grants
tools.description:
The grants the ADEME, the French ecological transition agency, awarded to one French company since 2021,
from its open dataset of financial aid: date of the agreement, amount in euros, purpose, aid scheme and
decision reference, most recent first, with the total count.

Use this to answer "did X receive public aid from the ADEME", "what subsidies did X get for its energy
transition".

ADEME alone: not all the public money a company received. Matched on the SIRET, never on the name.

siren.description: Nine-digit SIREN, spaces and dots accepted. A SIRET minus its last five digits.

tools.name: get_french_company_state_aid
tools.description:
The state aid published for one French company in the European Commission transparency register:
grant date, amount or tax-aid bracket, objective, instrument, granting authority (Bpifrance, regions,
ministries) and aid scheme, most recent first, with the total count.

Use this to answer "what public aid did X receive", "did the State fund X".

The register lists aid above a publication threshold only. Some ADEME grants are in both this tool and
the ADEME one: never add the two. Matched on the SIREN, never on the name.

siren.description: Nine-digit SIREN, spaces and dots accepted. A SIRET minus its last five digits.

tools.name: get_french_company_officers_insolvencies
tools.description:
The natural persons in office at one French company (at most five) and, for each, their OTHER companies
the official gazette placed in safeguard, receivership or liquidation: name, SIREN, procedure, date.
Answers "have the directors of X run companies that failed". No birth date, no personal sanction.

siren.description: Nine-digit SIREN, spaces and dots accepted. A SIRET minus its last five digits.
